desc: Simulate a vending machine that holds a credit, starting at 0, and return the messages it prints, in order. Coin(c): if c is 5, 10, 25 or 100, add it to the credit and print nothing; otherwise print "reject C" (C is the coin value) and do not add it. Select(p): if the credit is at least p, print "vend P change X" where X is credit minus p, and set the credit to 0; otherwise print "insufficient X" where X is the current credit, and keep the credit. Refund: if the credit is above 0, print "refund X" and set it to 0; if it is 0, print nothing. After the last event, if the credit is above 0, print "refund X" for it.

decls.canon:
type Event =
  | Coin(cents: Int)
  | Select(price: Int)
  | Refund
decls.ts: type Event = { kind: "Coin"; cents: number } | { kind: "Select"; price: number } | { kind: "Refund" };
